scope.case: only the frozen 0..4s paired repeat-move case
scope.parameters_and_types: original PI and adopted Current32/24 configuration, unchanged; local source hashes retained
scope.purpose: bounded simulation evidence for fixed-point migration, not general motion performance

limitations: Counterfactual common-sign replay is a causal diagnostic, not the production controller.
Original float/fixed samplewise failures and short-window tracking differences remain visible.
Profile-done holding windows include convergence; first three moves do not stay within 0.02mm throughout in either implementation.
No claim of unique attribution for every internal event, general input range, changed sequence, or hardware behavior.
Any changed types, PI, deadtime law, sample times, plant, command sequence or initial conditions needs a new review.
